title.narrative: Midterm Review of Organisation Strategy for Denmark’s engagement with Green Climate Fund (GCF) 2021-2023

description.narrative:
1) The continued relevance and progress in pursuing the priority areas and results defined in the Organisation Strategy for Denmark‘s cooperation with GCF in view of new developments. It will present recommendations for adjustments and updating of the priority areas for the next Organisation Strategy starting in 2023 and that will also outline the mandate that Denmark will take for setting its priority areas during the GCF 2nd replenishment process (GCF-2) expected to be initiated in the second half of 2022.
2) The extent to which the responsible unit (GDK), in collaboration with the Ministry for Climate, Energy & Utilities as well as other relevant units including embassies, has succeeded in facilitating linkages and synergies when relevant with the bilateral development programme managed by an embassy, regional and global programmes, other multilateral partnerships, humanitarian aid, private sector instruments as well as strategic partnerships with Danish civil society organisations.
